notes: Identity assessment: supplied canonical text is an author primary working paper, Demographics and Entrepreneurship, by James Liang, Hui Wang, and Edward P. Lazear, NBER Working Paper No. 20506; title page September 2014 and abstract page Revised November 2016. This matches the title and authors of the neutral reference, but is an earlier working-paper version, not the cited 2018 Journal of Political Economy publication. The cited JPE DOI is not established by this document. Text includes empirical results and tables, not merely an abstract. No PDF was supplied. All three assigned rows have null description/study identifiers and empty original locators. No outcome, coefficient, specification, or sample distinguishes their intended tests. The ser_method labels in rows 2080/2081 do not identify a test or establish coefficient standardisation; row 2137 has no requested metric. Row order and numeric matching were not used. Multiple country-year and country-age-year regressions and age-specific coefficients are candidates; no candidate is assigned to any row. Candidate evidence only: working-paper Table 2 (printed p. 56), country-year entrepreneurship-rate regression, column (1), r coefficient -0.041, standard error [0.007]***, Obs 393; column (2), OECD, r -0.023, [0.007]***, Obs 230. Table 3 (printed p. 57), country-age-year cell regressions, column (1), a -0.028 and r -0.038, Obs 17554; column (2), OECD, a -0.023 and r -0.021, Obs 10309. Both tables give significance thresholds rather than exact p for these coefficients: *** significant at 1% (p < .01). These are distinct candidate tests with distinct analytic units and samples; none establishes the assigned analytic N or a same-test effect/p pair. Table 4 (printed pp. 58–59 inspected) additionally contains age-specific r coefficients and age-group dummies. No metric conversion or N derivation performed. Only assigned unfinished fields were examined; unassigned fields/sides are null placeholders and must not overwrite previously verified values.
